decisions.reason: This ERP system interface plugin fits the firm's stated move toward broader multichannel and tailored commerce support, so sunk development effort and strategic commitment make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

Although one of several similar tracking plugins and therefore somewhat more dispensable, it still supports the firm's promise of measurable optimization and escalation of commitment favors keeping it.

Because it is close to the established e-commerce service stack and already publicly launched, management would likely continue it and justify weaker traction as product-specific or temporary rather than abandon it now.

The firm is still oriented toward multichannel optimization and has already invested in this adjacent plugin, so even with some portfolio overlap it would be more likely to persist than to cut it immediately.
This net price reporting plugin is a small, complementary extension of the core offer, and its modest maintenance burden plus prior investment make management inclined to retain it.
